name: Tamsin Roame
guide_text: The best strategy with this hero is to taunt up a start of combat unit that starts small to get your hero power proc, and then gains stats before it dies. The best one is [[Choral Mrrglr]]. [[Heroic Underdog||126966]] works as well.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for at most 3 gold. The buddy just acts as a tempo stick.
